title: Cursed Sword in the Depths
description: A skeletal hand grips an ornate silver longsword embedded in the ground. The dark cavernous background is filled with twisted roots, purple and orange glowing organic tendrils, and hanging crystalline formations.
prompt: A skeletal armored hand gripping a detailed silver longsword thrust into the ground in a dark decaying cavern. Twisted roots and glowing purple and orange organic tendrils wrap around the background, with hanging blue crystalline formations dripping from above, dark fantasy horror atmosphere, moody lighting, highly detailed digital painting
